    import sys

    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    m = int(input[1])
    d = list(map(int, input[2:m+2]))
    g = int(input[m+2])
    r = int(input[m+3])

    d.sort()
    islands = set(d)

    def bfs():
        queue = deque([(0, 0, 1)])  # (position, time, direction)
        visited = set((0, 0, 1))

        while queue:
            pos, t, dir = queue.popleft()

            if pos == n:
                return t

            next_green = ((t // (g + r)) * (g + r)) + g

            if pos + dir in islands:
                if (pos + dir, t + 1, dir) not in visited:
                    visited.add((pos + dir, t + 1, dir))
                    queue.append((pos + dir, t + 1, dir))
                if (pos + dir, t + 1, -dir) not in visited:
                    visited.add((pos + dir, t +1, -dir))
                    queue.append((pos + dir, t + 1, -dir))

            if t >= next_green:
                if pos in islands:
                    if (pos, next_green, dir) not in visited:
                        visited.add((pos, next_green, dir))
                        queue.append((pos, next_green, dir))
                    if (pos, next_green, -dir) not in visited:
                        visited.add((pos, next_green, -dir))
                        queue.append((pos, next_green, -dir))

        return -1

    print(bfs())

main()
